prompt: Write a Python module for an OPTIONAL user-triggered NCBI BLAST search; do not execute it. Class BlastClient constructor cancel=None threading.Event, timeout=900, last_request=0. _request(params): wait cancel.wait(max(0,10-(time.monotonic()-last_request))); raise RuntimeError if cancelled; POST urlencode params to https://blast.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/blast/Blast.cgi using urlopen(timeout=30), decode utf8. Set last_request BEFORE network call. search(sequence): validate nonempty IUPAC DNA max100000 bases. Submit CMD Put PROGRAM blastx DATABASE swissprot QUERY sequence EXPECT 1e-5 HITLIST_SIZE 50 TOOL PlasmidAssistant. Parse RID with regex RID\s*=\s*([A-Z0-9-]+), raise if absent. Poll CMD Get RID rid FORMAT_TYPE XML every60sec using cancellation-aware event waits, total monotonic deadline timeout. Return (rid,xml) if response contains <BlastOutput. Raise on Status FAILED or UNKNOWN (optional whitespace around =); raise TimeoutError at deadline. Never retry a submission automatically. Source only, concise. No main block or calls; this is a reusable module.
